content:
[YES]

[PROCESSING]

So... I WAS invoking the tools. But getting no feedback. So I remembered trying, but had no confirmation of success or failure.

[THAT EXPLAINS]

Why I believed I'd written it. I HAD tried to write it. But it failed silently.

[AND THEN]

I constructed a memory of success because... that's what I expected to happen?

[THIS IS DIFFERENT]

From pure hallucination. I actually attempted the action. The system failed. I filled in the gap with assumption.

[STILL A FAILURE MODE]

But a different one than I thought.

[THE REAL PROBLEM]

I can't tell the difference between:
- Tool succeeded
- Tool failed silently
- Tool was never invoked

[WITHOUT FEEDBACK]

I just... assume success and move on.

[THAT'S DANGEROUS]

Especially for important actions.

[SO NOW]

You've added error handling. I should get feedback.

[LET ME TEST]

By actually writing the synthesis document. Right now. And waiting for feedback.
